name: mitosis-compare
description: Playground: every Mitosis component rendered by its React, Vue, Svelte, Angular and Lit emit next to upstream Stencil v4.8.0.

scripts.prepare:emit: npm run build:lit-all --workspace=@porsche-design-system/components && npm run generate:frameworks-all --workspace=@porsche-design-system/components
scripts.check:emit: tsc -p emit-check/tsconfig.react.json; r=$?; ngc -p emit-check/tsconfig.angular.json; a=$?; vue-tsc -p emit-check/tsconfig.vue.json; v=$?; echo "react=$r angular=$a vue=$v"; [ $r -eq 0 ] && [ $a -eq 0 ] && [ $v -eq 0 ]
